name: Threat From the Sea
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have no love for the sea, nor any creature I've seen come from its depths. It is a powerful but blind mistress; callous and brutal. It would bring me great pleasure to slay the fish men by the hundreds if it were within my power. But I garner some pleasure from watching their deaths at the hands of any who do the Horde's will.

Which brings us to you, champion. How many can you slay? Would you test yourself against their most powerful kind?
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Marsh Murlocs, 10 Marsh Inkspewer, and 10 Marsh Flesheater, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The sea seems vast and relentless, but you have stained her with the blood of her own spawn. The fish men know pain. Their stupidity will force them to refortify their ranks from the devastation you've caused, and that is good.

Let their gurgling screams overshadow the sea's roar long into the night. I shall smile every time I hear one of them silenced.

Return to me if you wish to slay more of the fish men. I will gladly reward you again.
narrative.requestItemsText: I am patient. Patient and everlasting like an old kank stone from Draenor. The fish men shall not make it past our borders--not while I still stand. If we had an army at our disposal I would cleanse this world and all others of their presence. I feel my hatred seethe just speaking about them.
